judgments.value_text: Samsung planned to mass produce HBM3E 12H within the second quarter of 2024.
judgments.summary: At the April 30, 2024 Q1-results vintage, Samsung planned HBM3E 12H mass production within Q2 2024. The plan remains immutable; later Q3 evidence is evaluated separately and cannot rewrite its target or manufacture an onset date.

metadata.reality_guard: The April sentence reports 8H production as current while 12H remains forward-looking.
metadata.timing_guard: The target is Q2 at quarter precision; later state evidence with unknown onset cannot by itself establish whether the target timing was met or missed.
metadata.qualification_guard: No named customer/platform qualification is inferred.
